meta.title: Height Conversion — Convert Feet, Inches, CM, and Meters
meta.description: Convert height between feet, inches, centimeters, and meters instantly. Free online height converter for everyday use.

howItWorks: Enter your height in any supported unit (feet, inches, centimeters, or meters).
The converter instantly calculates the equivalent values in all other units.
Results update as you type — no need to click a button.
howToUse: Type your height in one of the input fields (e.g., centimeters).
The other fields update automatically with converted values.
Copy the value you need from the corresponding field.

faq.question: How many centimeters are in one foot?
faq.answer: One foot equals 30.48 centimeters. One inch equals 2.54 centimeters.

faq.question: Can I convert from feet and inches together?
faq.answer: Yes. Enter feet in the feet field and inches in the inches field. The converter combines them for the total height.

faq.question: Is this height converter free?
faq.answer: Yes. The height conversion tool is completely free with no limits or signup required.

formula: 1 foot = 30.48 cm, 1 inch = 2.54 cm, 1 meter = 100 cm
